about_the_game:
Wizard's Gambit — a Magical Clash of Strategy and Power

Step into the mystical world of Wizard’s Gambit, a fast-paced 2D strategy card game where magic, wit, and cunning decide the victor. Choose your faction, and test your skills in a duel of strategy and luck. Whether you’re a fan of card battlers or simply love fantasy worlds, Wizard’s Gambit offers an accessible yet competitive experience.

In this first build, the game introduces single-player mode, faction selection, and a full deck of magical cards, giving you a solid foundation to explore the world of spellcasting and tactical play. Each match challenges you to think ahead, combine abilities, and outmaneuver your opponent to claim victory.

Key Features

  • 🎴 2D Fantasy Card Battles – Simple to learn, tough to master.

  • 🧙 Faction Selection – Pick from four unique magical schools.

  • 📖 Full Deck of Cards – Unlock diverse spells and characters.

  • ☁️ Unity Cloud Save – Keep your progress across sessions.

  • 🧩 Strategic Gameplay – Every card you play shapes the board.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or higher
